description: This file defines instructor-related API routes for an LMS backend, including dashboard stats, course enrollments, submission stats, quiz attempts, pending submissions, course list, and assessments. It uses Express.js with TypeORM for database interactions and includes middleware for authentication and role-based access control.

methods.name: GET /instructor/dashboard-stats
methods.description: Provides KPIs such as active courses, enrolled learners, pending reviews, and learners at risk for the instructor dashboard.

methods.name: GET /instructor/courses/:courseId/enrollments
methods.description: Lists learners enrolled in a specific course, verifying instructor ownership.

methods.name: GET /instructor/courses/:courseId/submission-stats
methods.description: Returns quiz and assessment submission counts for a course.

methods.name: GET /instructor/courses/:courseId/quiz-attempts
methods.description: Lists recent quiz attempts for a course to the instructor.

methods.name: /instructor/submissions
methods.description: Lists all quiz and assignment submissions associated with the instructor's courses, for review purposes.

methods.name: GET /instructor/my-courses
methods.description: Provides a list of instructor's courses along with enrollment counts.

methods.name: GET /instructor/assessments
methods.description: Lists assessments created by the instructor, including submission counts and statuses.
